title: Eye Items
body:
In this mode, there are eye items, eye armors, eye block, eye ingot, eye ore, eye arrow, eye apple and eye steak. If you are playing Survival, this mode will be very useful. The properties of the items and armor are below. By the way, the structure of items and armor is the same as in Minecraft. All items are strong even netherite. Enjoy :)
